posts.title: Wazuh SIEM Lab — Building a Home SOC from Scratch
posts.content: Full walkthrough of deploying Wazuh in Docker, writing custom detection rules, building dashboards, and simulating attacks. Covers agent deployment, log collection, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and automated incident response.

posts.title: Buffer Overflows — From the Stack to Shell
posts.content: A practical deep-dive into stack-based buffer overflows on x86_64 Linux. Covers memory layout, register state at exploitation, return address overwrite techniques, NOP sleds, and bypassing common protections with custom vulnerable binary walkthroughs.

posts.title: C2 Architecture — Building a Minimal C2 Framework
posts.content: Design decisions behind a custom C2: HTTP/S vs DNS vs TCP protocol selection, AES-GCM encryption with key rotation, beacon timing with jitter, task queuing, and OpSec considerations. Source-level walkthrough of the ShadowGate framework core components.

posts.title: Active Directory Exploitation — A Practical Attack Path
posts.content: Walking through a full AD compromise chain from initial access to domain dominance. Covers SMB enumeration, Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, ACL abuse, lateral movement via WinRM, and DCSync — every step with tool commands and MITRE ATT&CK mappings.
